suggestions: I'm grateful for the deploy that went out clean on a Friday, no rollback needed, no Slack pings past 6pm.
I'm thankful for teh tarik from the stall near the office that somehow tastes better after a rough standup.
I'm grateful for the rain that started right as I stepped under the LRT overhang instead of two minutes earlier.
I'm thankful for waking up before Fajr on my own, no alarm needed, just the quiet doing its job.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a job that still pays even during the weeks I feel like I'm barely keeping up.
I'm thankful for my dad texting "dah makan?" without fail, even though he already knows I'll just say yes.
I'm grateful for a stack trace that actually pointed to the real problem instead of sending me down three wrong rabbit holes.
I'm thankful for the neighbour's cat that waits by my door like it's been expecting me all day.
I'm grateful for a colleague who covered my on-call shift without making it a whole thing.
I'm thankful for the smell of nasi kandar hitting the corridor right when I haven't eaten since breakfast.
I'm grateful for finding a parking spot right in front of the surau on a Friday when I'm running late for Jumaat prayers.
I'm thankful for a code review comment that actually taught me something instead of just nitpicking style.
I'm grateful for the LRT aircon finally working after weeks of standing room only with zero relief.
I'm thankful for my grandmother's voice on the phone, still calling me by the childhood nickname nobody else uses anymore.
I'm grateful for a Friday that ends with the group chat planning mamak instead of another postmortem.
